description_policy: Descriptions are paraphrased capture summaries, not verbatim source text. description_raw is null.
tag_policy: Page-level tags remain separate. Only explicit per-skill list entries and inline section tag prefixes are attached. Null tags mean no section-level mapping was recorded in this batch.

sections.name: Full Energy
sections.description_summary: Koko and all allies gain 45% damage reduction for 12 s; reduced damage is recorded and dealt back as true damage to allies when the effect ends. Allies also gain 30 Life Drain and 10% ATK. The effect cannot be dispelled and prevents Koko from recasting while active. Damage reduction scales to 55% at LV 3; Life Drain scales to 40 at LV 5.

sections.name: Fulfilling Feast
sections.description_summary: Heals the weakest ally for 230% ATK HP and grants 10% ATK for 5 s. Also feeds Patto, healing it for 350% ATK HP every 15 s and granting 20 Energy on Hit for 7 s. Healing scales up to 260% ATK.

sections.name: Patto, smash!
sections.description_summary: Deals 210% ATK to the target and increases damage they take by 10% for 5 s. If an enemy is adjacent, Patto smashes nearby enemies for 210% ATK and stuns them for 3 s; this secondary effect has an 8 s trigger limit. Damage scales to 240% ATK.

sections.name: Hero Focus
sections.description_summary: Increases Haste by 12/16/20.

sections.name: Fluffy Shield
sections.description_summary: After Full Energy's recorded damage is settled, all allies gain a 7 s shield that absorbs 15% of the total damage dealt by allies affected by Full Energy; scales to 20%. Higher levels remove allied control effects on Full Energy cast and grant Resilience.

sections.name: Enhance Force
sections.description_summary: After Koko feeds an ally with Fulfilling Feast, that target gains 25 Vitality for 6 s.

sections.name: Season Charm
sections.description_summary: Grants an opening bonus to the ally one tile in front: increased melee damage and reduced ranged damage received; higher ranks add Energy on Hit.

sections.name: Rivalry Mode
sections.description_summary: The first ally below 40% HP is healed for 160% ATK HP and receives a 160% ATK shield; refine grants Healing and Haste.

sections.name: Special Aroma
sections.description_summary: Creates and channels an aroma within 2 tiles from battle start. While active, Smokey & Meerky recover 50 Energy/s and allies in the aroma recover 21% ATK HP/s. Active cast heals allies in the aroma for 170% ATK and permanently levels up aroma effects: first expands range by 1 tile, second grants 30 Haste. If interrupted, aroma ends and cannot be recreated for 4 s. Healing scales to 31% ATK HP/s.

sections.name: Energizing Formula
sections.description_summary: Allies within aroma gain 16% ATK. Smokey & Meerky recover 5 additional Energy/s for each non-summoned ally affected. ATK scales to 20%; Energy bonus scales to 8.

sections.name: Quick Recovery
sections.description_summary: Heals allies within aroma for 90% ATK HP; scales to 120%.

sections.name: Hero Focus
sections.description_summary: Increases ATK by 6%; adds another 9% if at least three other non-summoned allies are in the aroma. Scales to +10% and +15%.

sections.name: Withering Potion
sections.description_summary: Adds a third level-up effect to Special Aroma, expanding its range by another tile. For 10 s after the third upgrade first occurs, enemies in range lose 12% max HP/s, capped at 200% of Smokey & Meerky's ATK. Higher levels increase the percentage and add a brief stun.

sections.name: Enhance Force
sections.description_summary: Increases healing from Special Aroma by 30% ATK.

sections.name: Season Charm
sections.description_summary: When applying a temporary stat buff to an ally, also grants Haste for the buff duration. Higher ranks additionally reduce damage taken.

sections.name: Rivalry Mode
sections.description_summary: The first ally below 40% HP is healed for 160% ATK HP and receives a 160% ATK shield; refine grants Healing and Haste.

sections.name: Colorful Dance
sections.description_summary: Heals allies in a forward 3-tile arc for 300% ATK HP and increases their ATK by 12% for 8 s; higher levels extend duration and raise ATK.

sections.name: Healing Gems
sections.description_summary: Heals the weakest ally for 50% ATK HP per second over 4 s.

sections.name: Blinding Light
sections.description_summary: Damages nearby enemies and heals allies in range; at LV 3 changes into a ruby or sapphire based on the target's damage type, reducing enemy Phys/Magic DEF and increasing allied corresponding DEF for 5 s.

sections.name: Hero Focus
sections.description_summary: Increases HP.

sections.name: Grand Entrance
sections.description_summary: At battle start, grants the bonuses of Colorful Dance and Healing Gems to the ally one tile in front of Fay; higher levels add Vitality.

sections.name: Enhance Force
sections.description_summary: The first time an ally under Healing Gems drops below 50% HP, Fay heals them for 200% ATK HP; once per skill cast.

sections.name: Season Charm
sections.description_summary: Grants an opening melee-damage bonus and ranged-damage reduction for the ally one tile in front; higher ranks add Energy on Hit.

sections.name: Rivalry Mode
sections.description_summary: The first ally below 40% HP is healed and shielded; refine grants Healing and Haste.

sections.name: Oath in the Stone
sections.description_summary: Cleanses dispellable debuffs from allies, equalizes the HP percentages of non-summoned allies, increases all allies' max HP by 150%, restores 1000% ATK HP, and grants 15% Morale. The temporary max-HP gain decays over 12 s.

sections.name: Undying Valor
sections.description_summary: Opening passive grants 20% team Morale; each 20% Morale grants all allies ATK equal to 10% of Rolan's initial ATK. The source excerpt also shows Haste and Temp Buff tags.

sections.name: Radiant Reign
sections.description_summary: At 100% team Morale creates a ward; when an ally casts an Ultimate, a radiant clone repeats it with inherited basic stats. The ward prevents Morale decay and, outside Boss battles, protects allies inside from stat reductions.

sections.name: Enhance Force
sections.description_summary: Adds Morale based on the most represented faction; special bonus applies to Lightbearer Empire or Celestials.

sections.name: Season Charm
sections.description_summary: Healing an ally increases their ATK temporarily.

sections.description_summary: Gaining a shield heals Callan for 15% of its max value. LV 2 improves Restless Guardian's opening shield to 600% HP and 80% incoming-damage absorption for allies within 2 tiles; Callan recovers 50% faster after the shield expires.

sections.name: Season Charm
sections.description_summary: Grants nearby allies an opening shield, repeating every 8 s; higher ranks reduce damage taken while shielded.

sections.name: Season Charm

sections.name: Enhance Force
sections.description_summary: While Frost Shield is active, instantly freezes and defeats enemies in Eternal Winter's domain below both the stated HP threshold and 15% HP percentage.

sections.name: Season Charm

sections.name: Season Charm
